6.341 rsNestedAggregateViaLookup
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsNestedAggregateViaLookup is a critical error that will occur when an aggregate function references a
Lookup, LookupSet, or MultiLookup function in its Expression parameter and the Lookup, LookupSet,
or MultiLookup function references an aggregate function in its Source expression parameter.
